company.name: Hiba Health
company.shortDescription: Hiba Health offers personalized healthcare with AI coaching and tele-health to reduce weight, A1C levels and improve wellness.
company.description:
Health-tech 

Hiba Health is a pioneering digital health platform dedicated to transforming weight management and combating obesity-related diseases, including type 2 diabetes. Leveraging advanced artificial intelligence, Hiba Health empowers individuals through education and behavioral change, enabling them to adopt healthier lifestyles and create personalized meal plans. The platform uniquely integrates GLP-1 medications such as Ozempic and Mounjaro with telehealth services and gamification features, providing a comprehensive and engaging approach to health improvement.

Founded by experienced entrepreneur Hiba Elchaki, Hiba Health is tailored to the cultural and dietary needs of the Saudi Arabian market, aligning with the nation's Vision 2030 healthcare innovation goals. By focusing on both mental and physical well-being, Hiba Health addresses the underlying factors of eating disorders and promotes sustainable health transformations. Committed to making quality mental and physical health support accessible and effective, Hiba Health aims to foster a healthier and more empowered community.
